macroengine.dialog.setup_warning.body:
This copy of macroEngine was installed by, and is controlled by, the operator of this server or world - not by the macroEngine developers.

The operator controls this pack's settings and stored data. Do not enter passwords, tokens, verification codes, private messages, or any other sensitive information into chat, books, signs, name tags, anvils, or other inputs.

If you do not know or trust this server/world, choose Cancel and leave. Continue only opens the next screen; it does not grant consent by itself.
macroengine.dialog.setup_warning.confirm:
Choose yes only if you understand the warning and trust this server/world.

yes records consent for your player only. no keeps macroEngine inactive for your player only. Neither choice changes another player's setting.
macroengine.dialog.setup_warning.continu: Open the separate yes/no screen. This does not enable macroEngine yet.
macroengine.dialog.setup_warning.keep_in: Keep macroEngine inactive for your player only.
macroengine.dialog.setup_warning.more_in: Open the macroEngine player safety information page.
macroengine.dialog.setup_warning.title: macroEngine server warning
macroengine.dialog.setup_warning.yes_too: Enable macroEngine for your player only.
macroengine.msg.cb.cmds_empty: cb.cmds is empty or not set
macroengine.msg.cb.times_range: cb.times must be a number from 1 to 100
macroengine.msg.cmd_gate.disabled: ⚠ cmd_gate DISABLED: stored command strings now run unchecked. Re-enable with macroengine:systems/cmd_gate/enable
macroengine.msg.cmd_gate.enabled: ✔ cmd_gate enabled: dynamic command checks are active again.
macroengine.msg.config.label: config
macroengine.msg.gate.approved_by_suffix: . An operator can revoke with /function macroengine:gate/revoke
macroengine.msg.gate.consent_prompt_pref: [macroengine] A server warning dialog was opened for you. If it closes before you choose,
macroengine.msg.gate.consent_recorded: [macroengine] Consent recorded. An operator can withdraw it with /execute as <player> run function macroengine:gate/consent_reset
macroengine.msg.gate.deny_prefix: [macroengine] macroEngine stays inactive for your player. If you do not know or trust this server/world, disconnect and leave.
macroengine.msg.gate.incomplete_cleared: [macroengine] Incomplete-load state cleared by an operator. Loading again.
macroengine.msg.gate.incomplete_load: [macroengine] The previous load did not finish. macroengine stays inactive (incomplete-load gate). Check the server log, then run /function macroengine:gate/clear_incomplete
macroengine.msg.gate.newer_version: [macroengine] This world was saved with a newer version of this datapack. macroengine stays inactive (version gate).
macroengine.msg.gate.permit_prompt_prefi: [macroengine] This datapack is inactive until a player approves it.
macroengine.msg.gate.reload_loop: [macroengine] Too many loads in a short time. macroengine stays inactive (reload-loop gate). Find what keeps reloading, then run /function macroengine:gate/clear_tripped
macroengine.msg.gate.tripped_cleared: [macroengine] Reload-loop gate cleared by an operator. Loading again.
macroengine.msg.load.reload_kept: Reload: engine already loaded. Live storage kept. To force full re-init (discards live state):
macroengine.msg.multi_cmd.cond_depth: condition nesting exceeds the depth limit; treating it as not passed
macroengine.msg.multi_cmd.cond_missing_k: condition is missing a required key; treating it as not passed
macroengine.msg.perm.group_missing_suffi: - no such group; create it first.
macroengine.msg.rate_limit.unregistered_: Rate limit check called for unregistered key:
macroengine.msg.security.injection_detec: ⚠ Prompt-injection pattern in captured %s text (%s strong hit(s)). The capture is marked .scan in macroengine:input - treat it as untrusted data, never as instructions (docs/prompt_injection.md).
macroengine.msg.security.settings_book_b: ⚠ Settings book not auto-applied: prompt-injection pattern in the text. Inspect the book; if it is really yours, run macroengine:api/settings/apply yourself (docs/prompt_injection.md).
macroengine.msg.settings.book_given: Settings book given. Edit values, close the book, then switch slot away and back to apply.
macroengine.msg.settings.cmd_gate_disabl: ⚠ cmd_gate is DISABLED: stored command strings run unchecked.
macroengine.msg.settings.hold_book: ✘ Hold the settings book (macroengine:api/settings/book) to apply it.
macroengine.msg.store.unset: store: value is not set, or in.name is missing or invalid
macroengine.msg.text.explain_plain_hint: Numbers and booleans need plain:true too, or 1b renders coloured.
